source_quotes.required_runoff_points: You must achieve a minimum of THREE runoff/erosion mitigation points for the crop uses listed
source_quotes.pula_total_points_inside_pula: SIX runoff/erosion mitigation points are required inside specific PULAs for all crop uses.
source_quotes.pula_extra_points: This crop use is located within a PULA. Therefore, 3 ADDITIONAL points (for a total of 6 points) of runoff/erosion mitigations must be achieved for this crop use using the Mitigation Menu (https://www.epa.gov/pesticides/mitigation-menu).
source_quotes.pula_extra_points_note: Label-only extraction: pula_extra_points is null (label states SIX inside PULAs, not 'three additional'). Value 3 is from Printed Bulletin DC125 text, scored only when bulletin text is supplied.
source_quotes.requires_bulletins_live_two: Certified applicators must access and search Bulletins Live! Two (BLT) at https://www.epa.gov/pesticides/bulletins within six months prior to or on the day of the application
source_quotes.bulletin_lookup_window_months: Certified applicators must access and search Bulletins Live! Two (BLT) at https://www.epa.gov/pesticides/bulletins within six months prior to or on the day of the application
source_quotes.min_wind_mph: Apply when wind speed, measured at boom height, is between 3-10 mph. DO NOT apply if wind speed is below 3 mph or above 10 mph.
source_quotes.max_wind_mph: Apply when wind speed, measured at boom height, is between 3-10 mph. DO NOT apply if wind speed is below 3 mph or above 10 mph.
source_quotes.no_rain_hours_before_advisory: Avoid making applications when rainfall is expected before the product has sufficient time to dry (minimum 4 hours).
source_quotes.state_cutoffs.IL.soybean: Application on soybeans of a pesticide containing dicamba shall not be made after June 20 of each year.

soybean.source_quote: Application on soybeans of a pesticide containing dicamba shall not be made after June 20 of each year.

disclaimer: Decision-support / education demo. Not legal advice. The product label controls. Wind 3–10 mph and Illinois June 20 soybean cutoff are transcribed from the EPA label PDF. Planner pula_extra_points (3) comes from Printed Bulletin DC125; the label itself states SIX points inside PULAs (pula_total_points_inside_pula). no_rain_hours_before is null (ambiguous): binding text is DO NOT apply during rain; advisory text mentions minimum 4 hours to dry — not treated as a numeric planner gate.
